title: Pure Fairy Tail
summary: Fairy Tail cards with generic staples; the page's White Forest and Azamina hybrids are left out. Every Fairy Tail monster is a 1850 ATK Level 4 Spellcaster, so Luna searches any of them and Fairy Tail Tales gives extra Normal Summons. The Blazing Dominion cards lead: Matchgiru summons itself next to an 1850 Spellcaster and searches the Spells, and Fairy Tail Ball and Matchgiru rename an opposing monster "Prince of Fairies", which Tails of the Fairy Tails and Teller of Fairy Tails then use as Fusion material. The page uses earlier translations for several of these (Matchlille, Wickat, Tales of Fairy Tail, Fairy Tail Long Long Ago); the TCG names are used here.
main: Fairy Tail - Matchgiru
2026 support. Summons itself next to an 1850 Spellcaster and searches a Fairy Tail Spell/Trap; renames their monster Prince of Fairies.
Fairy Tail - Luna
Normal Summoned: searches an 1850 ATK Spellcaster; bounces itself and their monster on either turn.
Fairy Tail - Rochka
Normal Summoned: the opponent picks one of your top three cards for you.
Fairy Tail - Sleeper
Flip: summons a monster from the hand; rewrites their Normal Spell/Trap.
Fairy Tail - Rella
Shields monsters from Spell targeting and borrows an Equip Spell.
Fairy Tail - Snow
Limited. Flips a monster face-down; returns from the GY by banishing seven.
Fairy Tail Ball
2026 support. Field Spell: searches a Fairy Tail; negates and renames a monster when they summon.
Once Upon a Fairy Tail
2026 support. Quick-Play: summons a LIGHT Fairy Tail each from your hand, GY and banishment.
Tails of the Fairy Tails
2026 support. Equip that Fusion Summons a Spellcaster, using their Prince of Fairies.
Fairy Tail Tales
Extra Normal Summons for 1850 Spellcasters, and blocks damage once a turn.
extra: 2026 support. Fusion: wipes their field with Prince of Fairies as material; banishes on their turn.
2026 support. Fusion: summons a Fairy Tail from the Deck and negates a monster.
2026 support. Rank 4: your LIGHT Fairy Tails are unaffected by their activated effects.
